name: lich-python
description: Python language adapter for Lich. Maps ruff rule IDs (~900 rules) into M-engine outputs and contributes Python-specific idiom rules (pyupgrade modernization, typing, async-await patterns, list/dict comprehensions). At launch: ~120 of ruff's 900 rules mapped; remaining tagged as Phase 2 coverage gap.
